subtitle: Find the Bug & Fix the Code Sequence!
description: An interactive computational thinking & debugging game inspired by Grace Hopper's discovery of the first computer bug in 1947.

levels.name: Rocket Waypoints
levels.instruction: Find the Bug & Fix the Code Sequence!
levels.hint: Watch the rocket animation and select what is happening!

options.label: Stop
options.correctExplanation: The rocket stopped prematurely at waypoint 1 instead of reaching the Star!

options.label: Repeat 3 Times
options.correctExplanation: Awesome! Repeating the move forward step 3 times lets the rocket reach waypoints 1, 2, 3, and the golden star!

options.label: Turn Back
options.explanation: Turning back won't help the rocket reach the star ahead.

options.label: Stop Rocket
options.explanation: Stopping won't get the rocket to the finish line!

levels.name: Lamp Circuit
levels.instruction: Find the Bug & Fix the Code Sequence!
levels.hint: Watch the circuit animation and select what is happening!

options.label: Switch
options.correctExplanation: The switch is in the OFF state, breaking the circuit so no electrical current reaches the lamp!

options.label: Switch ON
options.correctExplanation: Bingo! Flipping the switch to ON completes the circuit and energizes the lamp!

options.label: Change Lamp
options.explanation: The lamp isn't broken—it just lacks electrical power because the switch is open.

options.label: Boost Voltage
options.explanation: Increasing power won't work if the switch is in the OFF position.

levels.name: Fork in the Path
levels.instruction: Find the Bug & Fix the Code Sequence!
levels.hint: Watch the character animation and select what is happening!

options.label: Move Forward
options.correctExplanation: The character continued moving straight ahead into empty dead space instead of taking the turn!

options.label: Turn Left
options.correctExplanation: Excellent direction! Turning left steers the character down the path directly to the mystery gift box!

options.label: Turn Right
options.explanation: Turning right leads towards the toys, but our primary mission target is the gift box!

options.label: Turn Around
options.explanation: Turning around walks back to the starting point instead of progressing to the gift!

buggy: character.moveForward(); // Walked off into empty space!

levels.name: Stamper Machine Loop
levels.instruction: Find the Bug & Fix the Code Sequence!
levels.hint: Watch the stamper animation and select what is happening!

options.label: End
options.correctExplanation: The stamping loop stopped prematurely after only 2 stamps! It suffered an off-by-one loop error.

options.label: Repeat 1
options.correctExplanation: Perfect! Adding 1 more repetition completes the required quota of 3 stamped items!

options.label: Repeat 3
options.explanation: Repeating 3 more times would over-stamp the batch (5 total)!

options.label: Repeat Forever
options.explanation: Repeating forever creates an infinite loop and crashes the machine!
